name: online-examination-system
description: Online Examination System — academic web application. Source of truth: Online_Examination_System_PRD_v1.0.pdf

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @oes/shared && npm run build --workspace @oes/api && npm run build --workspace @oes/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @oes/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @oes/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/api/node_modules apps/web/node_modules packages/shared/node_modules apps/api/dist apps/web/dist packages/shared/dist
